title: Malicious users can mint the double Guaranteed Mints per RING
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  `HeroERC721A.sol` is an NFT contract, It guarantees the first phase **OG Phase** the whitelisted addresses will get:  - 1 Free Mint - 2 Guaranteed Mints per **RING** (RING is NFT, so they take a Snapshot for holders)  `HeroERC721A.sol#ogMint()` function is how users mint tokens for OG whitelisted addresses. Users who are eligible for the two types of OG mint have the flexibility to call `ogMint()` multiple times, So they can take the free mint and the guaranteed mint in two different transactions.
